name: token-usage-meter
description: Live local Codex token, prompt-cache, credit, and USD usage estimates.

interface.shortDescription: Live tokens, cache hits, credits, and cost.
interface.longDescription: Reads local Codex rollout metadata and shows a floating macOS widget or terminal dashboard for tokens, cache hits, credits, and estimated USD value. Automatically updates public official model prices and Fast-mode rates with offline caching.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open a floating widget showing my current Codex token usage, cache hit rate, credits, and estimated USD cost.
